module.title: Hyper-V host and virtual machine checks
module.description: Checks for a Hyper-V host: hypervisor health and capacity, logical processor load and the state, heartbeat, memory and snapshots of every virtual machine.
module.name: CheckHyperV

commands.check_hyperv_host: Check the Hyper-V host: virtual machine health summary and hypervisor capacity (logical/virtual processors, partitions).
commands.check_hyperv_cpu: Check hypervisor logical processor load (guest, hypervisor and total run time) on the host.
commands.check_hyperv_vms: Check virtual machines (state, health, heartbeat, uptime, memory, processors, snapshots, replication).
